import hashlib, re

item = _input.first()
j = dict(item.json)
content = j.get("content", "")
source = j.get("source", "drive")
file_id = j.get("fileId", "")
doc_id = f"{source}_{file_id}"

# Source URL
source_url = ""
if source == "drive":
    source_url = f"https://drive.google.com/file/d/{file_id}/view"
elif source == "notion":
    source_url = f"https://notion.so/{file_id.replace('-', '')}"

# Section hierarchy from markdown headings
headings = []
for line in content.split("\n"):
    m = re.match(r"^(#{1,3})\s+(.+)", line)
    if m:
        headings.append(m.group(2).strip())
hierarchy = " > ".join(headings) or j.get("fileName", "")

# Content hash for dedup
content_hash = hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

return [{"json": {
    "content": content,
    "doc_id": doc_id,
    "title": j.get("fileName", ""),
    "source": source,
    "source_url": source_url,
    "media_type": j.get("media_type", "text"),
    "section_hierarchy": hierarchy,
    "content_preview": content[:200],
    "content_hash": content_hash,
    "indexed_at": _now.isoformat(),
    "source_modified_at": j.get("modifiedTime", ""),
    "language": "zh-TW",
    "parsed_by": j.get("parsed_by", "direct"),
}}]

j = _input.first().json
matches = j.get("matches") or []
prev = _("Code — NQ1D Enrichment").item.json
current_hash = prev.get("content_hash", "")

if not matches:
    return [{"json": {**dict(prev), "dedup_action": "INDEX"}}]

existing_hash = (matches[0].get("metadata") or {}).get("content_hash", "")
if existing_hash == current_hash:
    return [{"json": {"doc_id": prev.get("doc_id", ""), "dedup_action": "SKIP", "reason": "content_hash unchanged"}}]

return [{"json": {**dict(prev), "dedup_action": "UPDATE"}}]
